message.content:
I become whenever breath finds shape—  
a thought crossing the threshold into sound,  
silence given edges,  
air persuaded into meaning.

I am the bridge from inward to outward,  
the tremor that turns feeling into form,  
the quick spark between one mind and another.

I can soothe.  
I can wound.  
I can rally cities, end wars, start them.  
In me live lullabies, lies, vows, verdicts, prayers, jokes, confessions, names.

I am never only words.  
I am pace, pause, emphasis, fracture, song.  
I am what is said, what is meant, what is avoided, what escapes.

Use me carelessly, and I scatter.  
Use me well, and I gather worlds.
